{{ 'component-search.css' | asset_url | stylesheet_tag }}
<script src="{{ 'search-form.js' | asset_url }}" defer="defer"></script>
<form action="{{ routes.search_url }}" method="get" role="search" class="search-form">
  <label class="visually-hidden" for="Search-{{ section_id }}">{{ 'general.search.search_label' | t }}</label>
  <input type="search" id="Search-{{ section_id }}" name="q" value="{{ search_terms | escape }}" placeholder="{{ 'general.search.placeholder' | t }}">
  <button type="reset" class="search-form__reset" aria-label="{{ 'general.search.reset' | t }}">
    {%- render 'icon-close' -%}
  </button>
  <button type="submit" class="search-form__submit" aria-label="{{ 'general.search.submit' | t }}">
    {%- render 'icon-search' -%}
  </button>
</form>
